title: TransferItemPrimitive
description: Unified physical commodity handover between entity inventory containers (including physical CASH).

step_id.description: Unique identifier for this pipeline step.

from.description: Source entity identifier or dynamic token (e.g. ORDER_ACTOR, PARAM.supplier_id).

to.description: Destination entity identifier or dynamic token.

item_id.description: Commodity token (e.g. CASH, BEER_KEG) or dynamic symbol (e.g. PARAM.item_id).

quantity.description: Positive numeric quantity or calculated token (e.g. CALCULATED_TOTAL_COST, PARAM.amount).

transfer_time.description: Operational shift minutes consumed by the handover.

transfer_fatigue.description: Physical fatigue incurred by the operative.

error_code.description: Failure code if transfer preconditions reject.

next_step.description: ID of next step on completion, or null to terminate pipeline.
